title: Degenerate Leray: H^q(X,F) = Gamma(Y, R^q f_* F) when the higher cohomology of the R^q f_* F vanishes
statement:
Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $\mathcal F$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module, an object of the abelian category $\mathrm{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $H^p(X,-)$ and $H^p(Y,-)$ be the cohomology of $\mathcal O_X$-modules and of $\mathcal O_Y$-modules, and $R^qf_*$ the higher direct images, the right derived functors of the direct image $f_*:\mathrm{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)\to\mathrm{Mod}(\mathcal O_Y)$, $(f_*\mathcal G)(V)=\mathcal G(f^{-1}V)$ [def-pc-module-pullback] [pqf-def-cohomology]. For $q\geq0$ let
$$
\varepsilon^q_{\mathcal F}:H^q(X,\mathcal F)\longrightarrow\Gamma\bigl(Y,R^qf_*\mathcal F\bigr)
$$
be the following map. Choose an injective resolution $\mathcal F\to\mathcal I^\bullet$ in $\mathrm{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions], so that $H^q(X,\mathcal F)=H^q(\Gamma(X,\mathcal I^\bullet))$ and $R^qf_*\mathcal F=\mathcal H^q(f_*\mathcal I^\bullet)=\ker(f_*\mathcal I^q\to f_*\mathcal I^{q+1})/\operatorname{im}(f_*\mathcal I^{q-1}\to f_*\mathcal I^q)$, the quotient taken in $\mathrm{Mod}(\mathcal O_Y)$. A cocycle $s\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal I^q)=\Gamma(Y,f_*\mathcal I^q)$ is a global section of $\ker(f_*\mathcal I^q\to f_*\mathcal I^{q+1})$, and $\varepsilon^q_{\mathcal F}$ sends the class of $s$ to the image of $s$ in $\Gamma(Y,\mathcal H^q(f_*\mathcal I^\bullet))$. Then: (1) $\varepsilon^q_{\mathcal F}$ is a well-defined homomorphism of abelian groups, independent of the injective resolution, and natural in $\mathcal F$: for every morphism $\varphi:\mathcal F\to\mathcal G$ of $\mathcal O_X$-modules, $\Gamma(Y,R^qf_*\varphi)\circ\varepsilon^q_{\mathcal F}=\varepsilon^q_{\mathcal G}\circ H^q(X,\varphi)$. (2) If $H^p(Y,R^qf_*\mathcal F)=0$ for all $q\geq0$ and all $p>0$, then $\varepsilon^q_{\mathcal F}$ is an isomorphism for every $q\geq0$.
